description: This file provides utility functions for validating, formatting, and converting phone numbers using the 'libphonenumber-js' library. It includes functions to validate phone numbers, format them for display, and format them for storage in E.164 format, handling various scenarios such as international numbers and default country codes.

methods.name: validatePhoneNumber(phoneNumber, defaultCountry)
methods.description: Validates a phone number input, checks if it's valid/possible, and formats it for display when valid.

methods.name: formatPhoneNumber(phoneNumber, defaultCountry = 'US')
methods.description: Formats a phone number into an international display format.

methods.name: formatPhoneForStorage(phoneNumber, defaultCountry)
methods.description: Converts a valid phone number into E.164 format suitable for storage.
